title: The Approval Window
tagline: One place my AI chats ask me for a yes, so they don't sit stuck.
what: When a chat needs my OK, it opens one big window on my screen with a plain-words brief, instead of stopping dead and waiting. My yes lets that one exact action run once, within 15 minutes, and the chat keeps working on its own.
built: One window for every question from every chat, plus a page I can answer from my phone
Each ask comes with a brief I can read cold: what, why, what changes, what could go wrong
A yes covers that one chat and that exact command, nothing else
If I'm away for 3 minutes or my screen is locked, my phone gets one nudge
credit: Built it on top of Claude Code
starring: Me, answering from my desk or my phone

making.problem: When a safety check blocked something, the only way to say yes was to switch the whole chat to manual mode.

steps.name: Ask
steps.says: The chat sends a short brief and the exact action it wants to run.

steps.name: Decide
steps.says: I say yes, say no, or write back a note, from the window or my phone.

steps.name: Use once
steps.says: The chat runs that exact action. The pass works one time, then it's gone.

moment.what: In its first two days my chats sent it 764 questions. I said yes to 330, typed a reply to 329 and said no to 13. Most of the rest I answered in the chat itself.
